name: Zion National Park
tagline: Zion Canyon shuttle corridor — red walls and riverside paths, not the full Narrows hike.

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass; seasonal shuttle required in the main canyon.
practical.transit_note: Park in Springdale or visitor area and ride the shuttle.
practical.energy_note: Heat in summer; shade is limited at midday.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → shuttle to one riverside stop → second stop if energy
practical.season_note: Shuttle season vs private cars changes by year — check NPS.
